credit: Kewe63 original durable-bundle proposal; yukkie3276 prior hash-cycle clarification and executable-fixture suggestion.
scope: Executable companion to an existing durable-bundle documentation proposal and prior hash-cycle review, not new server vulnerability.
limitations: Local profile/manifest schema/announcement marker are companion example choices, not an official Technocore wire standard.
Whole CLI subprocesses and unchanged pinned official DID verifier execute offline; all archives/room absence are synthetic, no actual room expiry/export observation.
Only the externally chosen DID/room announcement is verified; other archived records, extra unlisted files, unsigned seq/ts and raw JSON serialization are not authenticated.
Raw fixture archive bytes copied before tampering; valid reserialization remains signature-valid. Signature does not prove original export serialization.
Original string nonce007 remains verifiable; an integer7 record cannot recover that original signed spelling. Missing sig cannot be recovered.
Path/duplicate/size checks are a conservative local profile; symlink/reparse refusal code is present but actual link creation and hostile concurrent filesystem races not tested.
Explicit external verifier digest and expected DID/room must come from independent trust, not from an untrusted bundle; pinned verifier source is executed.
No real private keys or credentials in artifacts. Disposable fixture keys stay internal; user protected DID key never accessed.
No full Linux repository/original doc tests/upstreamCI, original branch modification/newPR/reviewer comment or adoption.
Initial fixture attempt was blocked in Windows sandbox default Temp before key creation; final run uses an explicitly checked workspace scratch path.
Official event review found no currently documented redeemable event in named pages; X latest posts inaccessible403. Existing forms are interest registration, not payout approval.
No personal DID-signed public message, wallet/testnet settlement, official role or airdrop eligibility established by this task.
